text:
lina: Quick sync - final slate + a 15m failover drill for the webinar next Thursday. can we do a brief run 2h before show to exercise demo fallback and push a banner?

ana: Yes. ops wants a single micro-drill that covers: induce fallback, switch OBS scene, tag inbound leads, and verify CTA link persists. keep it short.

mike: I can run the harness. plan: 90s baseline at 200rps, spike to 700rps, expect fallback if p99 > 1s. will post smoke curl and logs.

zara: i'll stage the 6B quantized image as fallback and add the routing rule. will annotate the change in the run-of-show.

ops-bot: ops-bot: recommended thresholds: p99_latency_ms > 1000ms for 2 windows OR oom count > 1 -> trigger fallback. will log event to /ops/logs/webinar.

lina: Good. host script line for fallback: "If we switch demo models during scale checks, features remain intact; you may see a brief change in response style." keep it 1 sentence.

ana: Also add a 1-line slide in the deck: "Demo may switch to a lower-latency model during scale tests; this is expected." designers will place it after the demo slide.

design-bot: design-bot: added contingency slide -> drive/webinars/assets/contingency_small.png

mike: Smoke curl for test (copy/paste):

curl -X POST https://staging-redwood/api/infer \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"prompt":"smoke","session_id":"webinar-drill-1","email":"ops+drill@example.com"}'

zara: routing snippet for the runbook (YAML):
```
routing:
  - path: /api/infer
    primary: redwood-13b
    fallback: redwood-6b-qtz
    conditions:
      - p99_latency_ms > 1000
      - oom_count >= 1
    lead_tag: webinar_demo_fallback
```

ana: mike pls also emit a small POST to OBS control when fallback happens: POST /scene {"scene":"fallback-banner","note":"demo-fallback"}.

mike: will do. ops-bot: can you capture that event and annotate the attendee recording timeline?

ops-bot: ops-bot: event capture enabled -> recording markers will include "demo-fallback" with session_id.

lina: Marketing asks: ensure the lead payload keeps utm and registration fields so trial CTA still maps. if fallback triggers, tag but DO NOT alter CTA.

zara: confirmed payload preserves utm and form fields. only adds tags array.

mike: drill executed in staging. fallback triggered at 00:45 of spike. observed logs: fallback_event:{"session":"webinar-drill-1","reason":"p99>1s"}. observability link: https://observability.redwood/runs/7889

ana: leo from sales reported Marketo received lead with tags ["webinar","webinar_demo_fallback"] and utm preserved. good.

lina: perfect. we'll mention this drill in the run-of-show notes under "stage ops" as a contingency. also schedule the 15m drill 2h prior on show day.

calendar-bot: calendar-bot: event created "Webinar failover drill" 2024-05-15 08:00 PT (15m). invites sent to host, ops, infra, design.

lina: final run-of-show snippet (compact 40m):
00:00 - 00:03  host intro + agenda
00:03 - 00:12  why inference economics matters (jamal)
00:12 - 00:22  benchmarks + tactics (zara)
00:22 - 00:30  demo (live) + contingency slide
00:30 - 00:37  customer micro-case
00:37 - 00:40  Q&A + CTA

ana: Reminders: speakers join dry run 45m prior, tech check 1h prior, failover drill 2h prior. speakers should keep that one-line contingency slide ready in their decks.

mike: thumbs up. pushing final checklist to drive and will circulate the smoke script.

zara: I'll sign off on model images and confirm artifact hashes in the runbook.

lina: Thanks team. closing thread — let's keep this thread for post-drill notes only. :sparkles:
